text:
anna: Heads-up — hosted-eu p99 jumped to ~1.9s at 12:03Z, baseline was ~600ms. Alerts from perf-dash triggered.
liam: seeing the same in APM. p95 also up to 850ms. Any recent rollouts?
sophie: I rolled out selector v2 to eu last night (small change to kernel scoring). Reverting now if it's related.
anna: ok can you hold rollback for 5min while we triage? first check: queue depth and rate-limiter counters.
infra-bot: metric spike: hosted-eu.queue_depth (12:02 -> 12:06): 18 -> 76 -> 22
reza: queue bouncing indicates short-lived backlog. Also seeing kvcache hitrate drop from 93% -> 68% at same window.
maya: noisy-tenant-42 had 3x token throughput at the same time window. Could be noisy neighbor priming long sequences.
liam: profile dump from a hot worker (sample at 12:04):
```
Top stack samples:
  kernel_selector::select_best  28%
  runtime::apply_batch        18%
  kv_cache::lookup            16%
  attention_kernels::compute  12%
  network::read               8%
```
sophie: kernel_selector accounted for more CPU than usual. v2 changed penalty for aux kernels, maybe causing frequent fallback churn.
anna: can someone grep logs for kernel switch events around 12:03?
reza: grep output shows repeated lines: `kernel=aux (fallback) reason=mem_pressure tenant=42` every ~200ms for a subset of requests.
liam: that matches kvcache thrash — falling back to aux kernels increases latency and CPU. Why mem_pressure?
maya: noisy-tenant-42 runs many long-context requests, their KV keys are large; eviction spikes in kvcache coincident with their burst.
sophie: rolling back selector v2 now (starting revert rollout) — will target eu workers.
infra-bot: deploy started: rollback-selector-v2 -> eu-region (batch 1/4)
anna: mitigation while rollback completes: temporarily throttle noisy-tenant-42 to 0.7x, and bump coalescer timeout to 8ms to reduce churn.
reza: issuing throttle patch to rate-engine: `tenant_limit noisy-tenant-42 0.7`
liam: bumped coalescer in staging; pushing to prod now.
sophie: rollback done for batch 1; early signs: queue depth dropped to 30, p99 -> 1.2s. Continuing batches.
maya: kv hitrate starting to recover: 68% -> 85% after first rollback batch.
anna: good. Once rollback completes, let's capture full pprof and flamegraphs for the 12:00-12:10 window, and annotate traces with kernel decisions.
sophie: agreed. I'll open an eval to simulate noisy-tenant burst to validate selector heuristics before we re-release.
liam: follow-ups: (1) add guard in selector to avoid rapid flip between kernels, (2) add kv cache eviction smoothing, (3) surface tenant priming rates in perf console.
anna: add a short postmortem thread after we finish profiling. For now I'll keep monitoring. :eyes: 
infra-bot: deploy completed: rollback-selector-v2 -> eu-region (4/4)
reza: final numbers (12:15): p95 = 620ms, p99 = 710ms, queue_depth steady ~10, kvcache hitrate 92%.
maya: noisy-tenant-42 throttle still active; recommend 24h cap until we have a better priming policy.
anna: thanks all — great quick triage. We'll write up root cause and the selector safety guards in follow-up. :thumbsup:
